items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And he told me, he said, Zutty, how can you stand that kind of stuff that's going on?

ctx.x: But what they were doing with this electronic stuff was.....

Marshall, you know a band leader from Notre Dame came in one night, that's when Notre Dame played somebody here in New York. And he told me, he said, Zutty, how can you stand that kind of stuff that's going on? He said, because I'm listening to you. See, because he knows the difference. This guy asked me, he was from Notre Dame wasn't he?
Yes. They had played football here that day.
